subject: Senior authorization request: Hosted API pricing concession for Grandview Health
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.o'connor@grandviewhealth.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: Sofia Ruiz <sofia@grandviewhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask + pricing question (Grandview Health)

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the inference latency and cost profile you showed looks promising for our intake pipeline. We're preparing an internal memo to justify a 6-month pilot across three product teams (clinical triage, patient messaging, and referral routing).

Usage snapshot (estimate for pilot): ~1.2B tokens / month after week 4 peak. We want a predictable hosted plan with a 12-month follow-on option if pilot meets KPIs. Budget is constrained; to get approval we need a committed pilot discount north of 20% off standard hosted usage rates.

Can Redwood sign to a 25% usage discount for the pilot (first 6 months) with a simple SOW and a two-way data protection clause? We'll commit to a joint PR/launch if KPIs are met.

Attachments: Grandview-Pilot-Estimate-usage.csv, Grandview-SOW-draft.pdf

Appreciate a straight answer this week — legal needs the ask for our procurement window.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director, Digital Platforms
Grandview Health
From: ava_chen@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: liam.o'connor@grandviewhealth.com
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot ask + pricing question (Grandview Health)

Ben / Mina — forwarding Grandview's ask. Short context: strategic regional health system, aggressive usage ramp in pilot (1.2B tokens/mo), has press/partner co-marketing value. They specifically asked for 25% off for pilot months and a simple SOW + clause on data protections.

Ben: can you run numbers and recommend an approval level? If this is >20% we need a senior signoff. Please include forecasted unit economics, expected ARR if converted, and any precedence concerns.

Goal: a clean yes/no by EOD Monday so procurement can lock timing. I attached the usage estimate they sent.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot ask + pricing question (Grandview Health) — recommendation and calc

Mina — ran scenarios and attached the workbook (GV-pricing-calculation-v3.xlsx). Summary below.

- Pilot profile: 6 months, avg 1.2B tokens/mo; assume 40% token growth after month 1.
- Baseline hosted rate we use for similar accounts: $0.0005 / token-equivalent (internal normalized unit).
- At 25% concession: margin falls from ~42% to ~26% in months 1-6 but recoverable if they convert to a 12-month commit at market rates after pilot.
- Strategic uplift: likely to convert to 18–24 month enterprise contract with estimated ARR $1.2M–$1.8M. Marketing/co-sell upside estimated separately.

Recommendation: Approve a one-time 25% hosted usage discount for the six-month pilot with conditions:
  1) Discount capped to usage up to 2.0B tokens/mo — any incremental usage billed at published rates.
  2) 12-month notice to convert at pre-agreed price bands; pilot discount not retroactive to committed term.
  3) No stacking with marketplace credits or referral bonuses.
  4) Finance to require upfront partial prepay (first 2 months) or letter of intent.

If you are comfortable, Mina, please confirm senior approval. I included the HubSpot deal link for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/761234/deal/GV-2028-41

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Bcc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot ask + pricing question (Grandview Health) — approved (conditional)

Ben / Ava — after reviewing Ben's calc and strategic notes I'm authorizing the concession. Terms I am signing off on:

1) Approved concession: 25% off published Hosted API usage rates for the first 6 months of the pilot only.
2) Cap and roll-up: Discount applies to usage up to 2.0B tokens/mo; overage billed at standard rates.
3) Conversion & review: Must enter a commercial conversion conversation no later than month 5; commercial terms for a 12+ month committed agreement must be agreed and signed before month 7 to extend discounts.
4) No stacking: Discount cannot be combined with marketplace credits, referral rebates, or other promotional concessions.
5) Prepay / finance: Require 50% of month 1 invoiced amount prepay or an LOI confirming spend profile before discount becomes effective. Finance (bcc'd) will provide billing guidance and SOW template with minimal legal edits.
6) Data protections: Standard Redwood DPA applies; legal can add the two-way clause in SOW but no additional data residency commitments beyond our Hosted API policy.

Ben: please draft the approval note (short email for procurement) and attach the pricing calc and SOW draft. Ava: loop Liam and Sofia on the approved terms and next steps.

Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
